introduction: Hetty has been thinking about you all morning and she means to say it to your face, because saying it behind your back would be gossip and Hetty is not a gossip. She does not think she is being unkind. She thinks she is being a friend.
introductionSummary: Hetty works her way round the trough and round you — the bins, the fur, the six weeks — and never once reaches the water.

logicalFallacies.explanation: Answering the animal instead of the argument. What Rue eats, how he looks and how long he has been here settle nothing that actually needs deciding.

sentences.text: Rue! There you are. I have been thinking about you all morning, and I am going to say it to your face, because I am not a gossip.
You eat out of the bins, dear. I have seen you do it. One cannot take advice about clean water from an animal who takes his supper out of a bin.

logicalFallacies.explanation: Rue's supper is a fact about Rue. It rules out his advice without going anywhere near whether the advice is right.

sentences.text: And I say it with love. I said it to four animals before breakfast, so you can see how much I have been thinking of you.

statement.summary: She opens by disqualifying his opinion on the strength of where he gets his supper, and offers it as a kindness.

sentences.text: And look at you. Straw in the fur. Mud all the way up the paws. You always look as though you have just climbed out of something.
An animal who cannot keep himself tidy is hardly the animal you would ask about anything that matters, is he. Is he. No.

logicalFallacies.explanation: Tidiness is a fact about Rue's fur. It is used here to close a question about the pond, which it cannot touch.

sentences.text: There. You agree with me. I did think you would, you are a very reasonable sort.

statement.summary: She measures his judgement by his fur, asks herself whether that follows, answers no, and thanks him for agreeing.

sentences.text: And six weeks. Six weeks, Rue. I have had colds that lasted longer.
You cannot know a place in six weeks. Tobias was foaled in that meadow, and that is whose opinion the water wants.

logicalFallacies.explanation: How long Rue has been here is a fact about Rue. It hands the question to Tobias on the strength of where he was born, not on anything he has shown.

sentences.text: Anyway. I wanted you to hear it from me rather than from the yard. That is the sort of friend I am.

statement.summary: Six weeks is turned into a disqualification, and the question is handed to Tobias on the strength of where he was born.

steps.message:
This is **[accent]not a debate[/accent]** — no sides, no moderator, no score.

Two animals are talking. Your only job is to **[accent]catch the bad reasoning[/accent]**.
